rules.scope_note: Reactor pressure vessel (incl. closure head); JSW ultra-heavy forgings
Delta-125 steam generators
Steam generator internals (shell, divider plate, tube supports, venturi, FW ring)
Canned-motor reactor coolant pumps (casings by Doosan)
Pressurizer
Accumulator tanks
Core makeup tanks
Passive residual heat removal heat exchanger
Control rod drive mechanisms (all CRDM assemblies/housings)
Reactor vessel internals (upper/lower internals, core barrel, support structures)
Integrated head package
Fourth-stage ADS squib valves
IRWST injection and containment recirculation squib valves
Steel containment vessel
PV-65 main steam safety valves
PV-62 pressurizer safety valves
PXS nozzle check valves (qualification per NRC IR; scope may not cover every PXS check valve)
Class 1E 250 Vdc battery banks
New and spent fuel storage racks (Holtec AP1000 rack supply; new-fuel rack attribution medium)
Refueling machine, fuel handling machine, fuel transfer system
Containment polar crane - PROBABLE supplier; never explicitly confirmed in public sources
IRWST steel formwork wall modules (tank formed by containment internal structures + site concrete)
CB20 passive containment cooling water tank L-modules (tank integral to shield building roof)
Main condensers (Toshiba scope, fabricated by BHI, Sacheon, Korea)
Main turbine system - part of Toshiba TC6F-52 STG supply scope (incl. turbine stop/control valves)
